message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: Jan Ole Helmbold, your video on Palm Pre in 2026? caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth, and your insights on mobile devices could offer teachers and school leaders practical perspectives. We would love to discuss an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed, offering teachers and academic leaders useful technology guidance. Would you like to see a one-page outline before deciding?
message.dm: Jan Ole Helmbold, your smartphone content caught our attention. Would you be open to discussing an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video with EDXSO?
